text: {"table": {"name": "posts", "purpose": "Stack Exchange-style Q&A posts (questions and answers, apparently from Cross Validated / stats.stackexchange.com given the statistics-related content). One row per post; questions and answers share this table, distinguished by post type."}, "columns": {"col_001": {"role": "identifier", "name": "PostId", "description": "Primary key of the post. Referenced by comments, postHistory, votes, postLinks, tags.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_002": {"role": "category", "name": "PostTypeId", "description": "Post type code: 1 = question (42,912 rows), 2 = answer (47,755 rows); rarer values (3-7) likely wiki/moderation post types (e.g. tag wiki, moderator nomination).", "status": "resolved"}, "col_003": {"role": "identifier", "name": "AcceptedAnswerId", "description": "Id of the answer accepted as the solution; set only on questions that have an accepted answer (null 84% of rows). Values fall within the post-id range.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_004": {"role": "date", "name": "CreationDate", "description": "Timestamp when the post was created (2009-2014).", "status": "resolved"}, "col_005": {"role": "numeric", "name": "Score", "description": "Net vote score of the post (upvotes minus downvotes); can be negative (min -19).", "status": "resolved"}, "col_006": {"role": "numeric", "name": "ViewCount", "description": "Number of views; populated only for questions (null for answers, 53% null).", "status": "resolved"}, "col_007": {"role": "free_text", "name": "Body", "description": "Post body in HTML (questions and answers).", "status": "resolved"}, "col_008": {"role": "identifier", "name": "OwnerUserId", "description": "Id of the user who created the post; -1 denotes a system/community user. References users.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_009": {"role": "date", "name": "LastActivityDate", "description": "Timestamp of the most recent activity on the post (edit, answer, comment); never null and always >= creation date.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_010": {"role": "free_text", "name": "Title", "description": "Post title; populated only for questions (null for answers).", "status": "resolved"}, "col_011": {"role": "category", "name": "Tags", "description": "Angle-bracket-delimited tag list, e.g. <regression><r>; populated only for questions.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_012": {"role": "numeric", "name": "AnswerCount", "description": "Number of answers to the question; populated only for questions.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_013": {"role": "numeric", "name": "CommentCount", "description": "Number of comments on the post; never null, applies to both questions and answers.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_014": {"role": "numeric", "name": "FavoriteCount", "description": "Number of users who favorited/starred the post; populated only for questions (86% null).", "status": "resolved"}, "col_015": {"role": "identifier", "name": "LastEditorUserId", "description": "Id of the user who last edited the post (-1 = community user); null when never edited. References users.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_016": {"role": "date", "name": "LastEditDate", "description": "Timestamp of the last edit; null when the post was never edited (51% null).", "status": "resolved"}, "col_017": {"role": "date", "name": "ClosedDate", "description": "Timestamp when the post was closed (off-topic/duplicate etc.); null for the 97% of posts not closed.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_018": {"role": "identifier", "name": "ParentId", "description": "For answers, the Id of the parent question; null for questions (48% null, matching the answer share).", "status": "resolved"}, "col_019": {"role": "date", "name": "CommunityOwnedDate", "description": "Date the post became community wiki (no longer attributed to a single owner); null for 98% of posts.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_020": {"role": "free_text", "name": "OwnerDisplayName", "description": "Display name of the post owner when no user account is attached (e.g. 'user28'); mostly null.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_021": {"role": "free_text", "name": "LastEditorDisplayName", "description": "Display name of the last editor when no user account is attached; almost always null.", "status": "resolved"}}}
